domain: Food Safety Inspection and Reporting System
scenario:
A municipal health department is implementing a comprehensive Food Safety Inspection and Reporting System to improve public health by ensuring food service establishments adhere to food safety regulations. This system will facilitate the scheduling, execution, documentation, and analysis of health inspections conducted across restaurants, cafeterias, and other food service entities.

The system must manage detailed records of inspections, including the specific items inspected, the findings, and any critical violations observed. Inspectors will record their findings, such as cleanliness issues or improper food handling practices, in real-time using a mobile application. The system will also allow inspectors to attach comments and recommendations for corrective actions.

To support data-driven decision-making, the system will generate analytics and reports, highlighting trends in compliance and areas needing improvement. The health department will use these insights to guide educational initiatives and targeted inspections. The system will also manage inspector assignments, track inspection history, and ensure follow-up on critical violations.

Furthermore, the platform will include a public-facing portal where health scores and inspection summaries are accessible to the public, promoting transparency and allowing consumers to make informed dining choices. The system will have robust user management to control access levels for inspectors, administrators, and the public.
